The '''Attack on Bannistar Station''' was a conflict during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that took place when the ''[[Rebel One]]'' accidentally ended up at [[Bannistar Station]].

==Background==
After the [[disaster at Deepspace Besh]] the heavily damaged ''[[Rebel One]]'' jumped randomly through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], ending up at [[Bannistar Station]]. Instead of fleeing the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] decided to infiltrate and destroy the station.

==The battle==
[[File:Reb14-BannistarBurning.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Bannistar Station being destroyed]]
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] discovered the ''[[Rebel One]]'', they moved in to inspect. The ''Rebel One'', however, overloaded its engines and exploded. Using the explosion as a distraction, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] infiltration team made their way to [[Bannistar Station]]. Before they could sabotage the station, however, they were captured.
[[Deena Shan|One of the Rebels]] had avoided capture continued on her mission. Shortly after she too was discovered and was forced to flee. She ended up high above a refueling [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and dropped one of her [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] down the fuel line.
The following explosion took out an entire section of the station. The captured Rebels used the ensueing chaos to free themselves and escape the station in a stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. With the help of [[Dagger Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Dagger Squadron]], sent by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], they made their way back to the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]].
